column1: # CMP2 group 227: Zephal aftermath and Pandemonium recruit branches (000D20F6-000D5342)

column2: Hey, $$レブロブス$$... Later, remove the talisman stuck to that girl's back...
Do that for me...
And you should stay a little farther away from me...
Being controlled by someone... sure is rough, huh? Heh!
When I was fifteen...
I was told by my trainer that my mother had slit open her own belly during a fight with a man named $$ゼファル$$...
and that my father followed after her, dying in what amounted to a suicidal charge...
That's what my trainer told me...
But when I heard that story, I didn't question it at all...
I thought my parents, like I was then...
must have grown weary of their days of doing nothing but fighting...
That's what I told myself!
But after several years had passed...
I killed the $$領主$$ who had been my $$飼い主$$ and traveled with others in the same circumstances...
Then $$ゼファル$$, who had become a $$奴隷ハンター$$, ambushed us!
He kept mocking us for having a woman among us...
And the instant he cast his spell!
A girl I had $$愛$$d like a little sister suddenly began to suffer...
and exploded to death before my eyes!!
I lost my head and let him get the better of me. That is how I ended up thrown into that $$ゴルゴダ$$ prison...
But later, once I had calmed down, I finally realized that my parents...
had been killed the same way.
In that case...
your parents must have been some truly wicked people, too.
What did you say!?
Well, think about it...
By your account, your mother had her mind taken over by that talisman...
which means she forced herself to kill herself...
so she would not take her husband down with her...
And your father, losing his head when his wife died...
makes him sound like someone much like you.
I always knew there was something behind him, but...
I never imagined his nickname held that kind of meaning...
Do you still have $$記憶$$ of the time he was controlling you!?
I am truly... terribly sorry...
To my...
new $$ご主人様$$s, for doing something so awful...
I will surely repay you someday...
I am so... sorry!!
After...
after you saved me so many times...
I... I should have killed myself...
I should have killed myself, too...
I had no $$自由$$ over my body or speech at all...
but my consciousness remained clear...
I'm sorry!!
My real name is $$クレージュ$$!
My $$記憶$$ from before I joined that band of $$盗賊$$s are still so muddled I cannot remember clearly, but...
please believe this much: I put on that armor because I longed for strong men...
I want you to believe that...
So what will we do with her? Will we remove her from the group after all!?
No. Leave that decision to her.
$$ゼファル$$ said it too...
Having someone else decide how you should live...
or control you is no pleasant feeling!
Even if it is a $$自由$$ that works only among us...
we all want $$自由$$, don't we?
My real name is $$クレージュ$$!
It was wrong of me not to tell you, but you should be embarrassed for not realizing it too...!
What did you call this woman!?
Hey, doesn't it seem like there are more of us?
Um, one, two, three... Oh, you're right! Who are you?
Who are you?
I'm $$ミニオン$$. It looked fun, so I came along!
Hee hee!!
Hee hee my ass. Get home, now!!
Aww, can't I come with you?
Come along
Go away!
Yay, wonderful!
$$ミニオン$$ joined the party!!
Fine, then. Bleh!
Good grief...
I am the $$奴隷$$ $$ライラ$$.
If you would permit it... would you use me as your $$奴隷$$?
I am not good at fighting, but please at least command my $$夜伽$$...
Not as a $$奴隷$$—as a companion
I'm sorry!
$$ライラ$$ joined the party!
$$ライラ$$ left.
Oh, you do not seem to be with the $$アンゲルス教$$.
Will you save me?
Thank you. My name is $$フィム$$!
Take her with you!!
Do not take her!
Yes!! I must repay the kindness you have shown me!
$$フィム$$ joined the party!
Yes!! I can manage to escape on my own now!
Thank you deeply for defeating $$ゼファル$$...
I will surely repay this kindness on the battlefield...!
Glad to have you
What are you talking about?
$$シャムシェル$$ joined the party.
$$シャムシェル$$ left.
Are you folks... the ones who defeated $$ゼファル$$...?
No one had kept me as a $$奴隷$$ all week...
I was about to be fed to the beasts...
So I'm reeeally grateful!!
So, will you join us?
So what?
$$エルリム$$ tearfully joined the party!
$$エルリム$$ tearfully left.
Hey, hey, you knights are journeying to seek the truth of the $$世界$$, right?
Maybe? I don't really know...
Eek, that way you talk is so cuuute.
Hey, take me too. I won't be dead weight—I can dance in back and cheer you on!
How can you say that? I don't know what to do.
So, what should we do?
Take her with us
Do not take her
Yay, wonderful!! Do your best, knight!
$$ルビィ$$ joined the party!!
Tch, fine. Do your best, knight.
Why are the white $$羽$$ people who want to join us always so featherbrained!?
It cannot be helped... after all, for white $$羽$$ people to learn to read and write
is itself strictly prohibited as a $$罪$$.
Most white $$羽$$ people have received no real education in all their lives...
Conversely, anyone who has received a proper education would never think of defying God...!
Everyone... I am sorry I made you detour for my sake...
I am sorry...
Do not worry about something so trivial...
Besides, this time we learned just how much of a fool you are...
It was entertaining in all sorts of ways!!
What did you say!?
Nyaa-nyaa, fool, fool!!
Now, now. Once we cross this hill, $$ユダ$$ said we will at last reach the $$大邪神$$ armor...
The city of $$パンデモニウム$$.
From here on, we must be even more vigilant...
Hey...
Somehow, even I am beginning to understand a little what the word $$愛$$ means...
No! It's nothing...
